name: AddButtonCode
evidence: links a button-code record into the list D_00262DFC unless it is already in it (func_0016F588 calls it for each of the nine)

name: ResetButtonCodes
evidence: sets every listed button-code record's position back to 0 (RunCompletedButtonCode calls it after each run)

name: AdvanceButtonCodes
evidence: on a pad button change, moves each listed record's position on when the pressed mask is its next one and back to 0 when not

name: RunCompletedButtonCode
evidence: once the delay AdvanceButtonCodes set has passed, unlinks the records marked for removal, runs the callback of the completed record with the longest sequence, then resets every position

name: RegisterButtonCodes
evidence: adds the nine static button-code records D_00262A80 .. D_00262C48 to the list, one AddButtonCode each

name: g_buttonCodes
evidence: the head of the button-code list: AddButtonCode pushes onto it, AdvanceButtonCodes and RunCompletedButtonCode walk it
